matches.text: [F1] [[lem-ip-borel-jet-realization-and-beam-patching]] realizes compatible transverse jets uniformly on compact parameter intervals. For a curve with projected crossings, apply its single-segment construction to the embedded graph $(\pi\Gamma(s),s)$ in $X\times\mathbb R$, and then restrict to separate local branches. The chartwise jets agree on open overlaps by the jet ODE uniqueness; no extension from merely pointwise-compatible jets on a crossing union is invoked.
